cards.p: Because "I cannot find my product" covers four separate problems that produce the same empty screen.
The expensive mistake is to meet an organic ranking problem by raising bids: a higher bid cannot put you in the organic results, because organic position is not for sale.
In Campaign Manager, set the date range to the last 7 days and look at Spend. If Spend is above $0.00, the ad was served in that period.
Amazon's advertising documentation states that an ad for a listing not eligible for the featured offer will not display to shoppers, and that ineligible ads are flagged in Campaign Manager.
